answer: Streak-based multipliers at the lotus: reputation r scales as r0·2^(s/30) where s is consecutive verified epochs. The nebula aggregates independent witness signatures, requiring 3-of-5 distinct nodes per epoch. Breaking a streak resets the vine to s=0, so a sybil farm splitting identities across k nodes pays k× the epoch cost while earning 1/k the multiplier. At 30 epochs, faking one high-rep identity costs 2^30× a fresh one. Works because compounding rewards honest continuity and makes forgery exponentially expensive.
